findings.issue: Uncaught error: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'replace')
findings.fix: renderProps → elName(): ELABEL has no entry for the new “callin” element, so selecting a call-in card in Layouts throws and the properties panel stops rendering. Add ELABEL.callin = "Call-in card" and fall back to e.type.

findings.issue: Present menu items can’t be reached (Share screen, Play a video, Present slides, Show an image, On-air AI)
findings.fix: At ≤900px .dock-tools has overflow-x:auto, which clips the absolutely positioned Present menu, and the rail sits on top. Move #presentMenu out of .dock-tools (portal to body / position: fixed above the dock) with z-index over .rail.

findings.issue: No way to hide a QR card where it was added: the Brand “On stage” button stays the same after it’s shown
findings.fix: Make the button a toggle (“On stage” ↔ “Hide”), and add a hide control to the card in Layouts and on the stage editor.

Deck people cards: the card is taller than the 112px deck row allows, so the grid squeezes and the name rides up under the thumbnail. Give .deck-body ~124px, or drop .crew-sub on deck cards, or shrink the thumbnail to aspect 16/8.
Help: .sec heading has negative/zero bottom margin against the list; add margin-bottom: 8px to #helpPopWrap h3.sec.

missing.AI image maker outside the wizard: Image generation exists only inside “Start a stream → thumbnail”. It can’t make a stage background, overlay or sponsor image from the Brand panel, and the AI producer can’t generate an image on request.
missing.Media library sync: The media library lives in one browser (IndexedDB). It does not follow the account to another computer and guests can’t see it; uploads to storage (e.g. Vercel Blob) would fix that.
missing.Slide overview: No slide thumbnails or “go to slide N” for PDFs. Long decks need a grid to jump around, and presenter notes aren’t shown.
missing.Timed QR / support card: QR and call-in cards stay up until removed by hand. Show-for-N-seconds, or auto-show every N minutes like the sponsor rotation, would match how shows run donation calls.
missing.Banner editing on stage: Banners can only be edited in the side panel: no click-to-edit on the stage, no per-banner colour/style override, no queue to step through a run of banners or tickers during a show.
missing.Restreaming to platforms: Going live on YouTube, Twitch, X, Kick, Rumble, TikTok or Facebook needs an RTMP relay (browsers can’t send RTMP). Today gather records locally and reads Twitch/Rumble chat; it does not push video to any platform.
missing.Cloud recording / save to Drive: Recordings download from the host’s browser only. No upload to Google Drive or Dropbox, no separate per-person ISO tracks, no cloud copy if the tab closes.
missing.Phone dial-in: The call-in line is a WebRTC link. Real phone numbers (PSTN) need a telephony provider (e.g. Twilio) bridged to the studio.
missing.YouTube / X / TikTok chat: Only Twitch and Rumble chat are connected. YouTube needs Google sign-in (OAuth); X needs a developer app; TikTok has no official chat API.
missing.Durable bans: Removing someone ends their session, but nothing stops them rejoining with the link except locking the studio.
missing.Production checks: No typecheck/lint/build pipeline exists (plain JS, no bundler), and the Playwright suites live outside the repo.
